Lot 1 - 1 St. Marys Street, Carmarthen, Dyfed, SA31 1TN

Description

ONLINE AUCTION from 6th October-8th October 2026

A substantial town centre commercial premises arranged over lower ground, ground, first and second floors. The property was most recently used as office accommodation and includes a reception area, a number of office rooms, kitchen, WC facilities, storage and basement accommodation, including a former tunnel room.

The property occupies a prominent corner position within Carmarthen town centre, a short walk from Nott Square, the historic castle walls and the town’s shops and services.

Condition
The property requires full refurbishment and modernisation throughout. Parts of the upper-floor accommodation have damaged and unsafe flooring and must not be accessed. Prospective purchasers should exercise extreme caution when viewing and satisfy themselves as to the condition and structural integrity of the building.

Location
Carmarthen is the principal town of Carmarthenshire, serving a wide West Wales catchment. The town has a range of national and independent retailers, public-sector employers, a university campus, hospital and railway connections. The A40 provides access to the wider road network and the M4 corridor.

Potential
Scope for continued commercial use, refurbishment and reconfiguration, or redevelopment of the upper floors for residential or other alternative uses, subject to all necessary planning permissions and consents.

Suited to
Builders, developers and commercial investors seeking a substantial freehold town-centre building requiring a comprehensive refurbishment project.

Tenancies

To be sold with vacant possession

Tenure

Advised Freehold - to be verified by solicitor
